algolia.name: Mobee - Magic Charger for Apple® Magic Mouse
algolia.description: Keep your Apple Magic Mouse fully powered with this Mobee Magic MO2212A charger, which includes a 270 mAh battery pack that replaces the existing 2 AA batteries in your Magic Mouse for long-lasting operation. The wireless charging station simplifies use.
